key_findings.note: Both contrasts with their comparison groups (p.15).

Ad raised Democratic representation and public-service motives (F3); narrative first lowered representation relative to ad alone (F5); motives estimates in both comparisons not robust to Bonferroni (F11). Directions are correct.

Ad reduced valuation of diverse life experiences (F10; the 'not hypothesized' point is not in this entry but stated in scope entry 11); null on complexity of representation for narrative first (F9, H1E). The 0.79 SD H1C result is accurate but not gold.
